_note: BACKSTOP for cards RiftScribe genuinely lacks (e.g. TCGplayer Organized-Play / promotional printings). Most 'missing' cards are just prod being behind the snapshot — run `npm run cards:sync` FIRST. Only add a card here if it's still missing after that. `externalId` must be unique and stable (use it for promos so they never clobber the base card). imageUrl from a TCGplayer product URL tcgplayer.com/product/<ID>/... = https://tcgplayer-cdn.tcgplayer.com/product/<ID>_in_1000x1000.jpg . Nexus Night 1 organized-play promo prints — these were being wrongly scraped and shown on /sealed as a 'Nexus Night Pack' sealed product (fixed in sealed-import.ts), when each is really a single promo printing of an existing base card. Domain/type/rarity inherited from the real OGN base card of the same name. No confirmed distinct collector number exists for these prints, so 'NN1' (Nexus Night 1, the event name on the actual listings) is used as a non-numbered designator, same convention as Buff // Buff's 'P'. Includes the full 6-domain Rune cycle (Fury/Calm/Mind/Body/Chaos/Order) — only Calm and Body were originally added; the other four were the same NN1 promo set and were missing.

Vendetta Signature ('*') Legend pulls — playriftbound.com's own card gallery hasn't posted these yet (Signature prints always trail the base reveal), so fetch-vendetta-official.ts can't see them. Sourced from real eBay listings (buyer-submitted photos, cross-checked against each other for the rules text/collector number), NOT RiftScribe/official art. imageUrl points at our own re-hosted crop of that photo (public/signature-cards/) as a stand-in thumbnail — swap for the official CDN asset once cards-sync/vendetta-pipeline catalogues the real print (same externalId, so it adopts in place, no duplicate). domain is the Legend's FIRST printed domain only, same simplification fetch-vendetta-official.ts's own o.domain.values[0] makes for every other Legend in this file — each of these six is actually dual-domain (Zed Fury/Chaos, Kennen Chaos/Body, Shen Calm/Body, Renekton Fury/Body, Mel Mind/Chaos, Jayce Mind/Body per the two domain pips on the card), the DB just doesn't have a second-domain column yet.

The cards themselves are confirmed real: a community-compiled 'every Riftbound rune variation' reference chart shows each one with its official collector code (VEN R0Na/SC) and artist credit (Greg Ghielmetti (c)2026RGI) printed on the card face. DELIBERATELY IMAGELESS: the only printing on that chart is the SIMPLIFIED-CHINESE release, whose card name and type line are Chinese (e.g. Fury Rune reads 炽烈符文), so it is the wrong thumbnail for an English-language price site — cleared to null so the generated placeholder renders instead, the same call fix-cloned-art.ts makes for a variant with no correct art. Drop the English scans in and set imageUrl once they surface. Domain assignment is from the chart's clearly English-labelled Origins rune cycle, which shares the symbol-per-domain art language (Fury=spiked trigon, Calm=leaf teardrop, Mind=crescent+orbit, Body=diamond 'N', Chaos=pinwheel spiral, Order=winged S).

Riftbound x T1 2025 Worlds Champion Collection (setCode T1S, printed bottom-left as "T1S · NNN/005 · EN"). Riot distributes this collection by Riot Merch Store DRAWING, not through retail, so it will never appear in RiftScribe, TCGplayer's catalogue or the riftbound.gg sitemap the automated pipelines read — this file is the only way these six printings exist on RiftCompare at all. Card data was read off Riot's own reveal renders (re-hosted at public/t1-worlds-cards/, cropped out of the composite on the reveal page — same self-host approach as the Vendetta Signature block above, never a hotlink). CROSS-CHECKED, not guessed: Xin Zhao/Galio/Miss Fortune already exist in our DB as base printings (SFD 176, UNL 171, OGN 193) and their domain/type/cost/might match these renders exactly, and Ambessa, The Wolf matches VEN 084 (Body, Unit, 4 energy, 4 might, identical Empower text). Seraphine, Not Alone has no other printing — it is from the unreleased Radiance set and is NOT tournament-legal until Radiance ships — so its Order domain is read from the yellow domain bar, the same colour as the two DB-confirmed Order cards in this same frame. rarity is Showcase for all six per constants.ts chasePrintRarity(): every card here is a special treatment (new art, new frame, new foiling) of another card, so it belongs in Showcase rather than cluttering the base tier its retail printing sits in. NO SETS ENTRY on purpose — T1S is a sealed collector product, not a playable set, and adding it to constants.ts SETS would push a 5-card 'set' into pack-sim, box-EV, movers and the homepage set grid. These cards carry no store listings (they cannot be bought as singles), so card-price-state.ts noindexes their pages until secondary-market listings appear — which is correct and self-healing. Run: `npm run cards:manual` (or maintenance.yml task=cards-manual).

_note: The serialised, gold-signature print. "003*/005" is the collector number printed on the card, so isSignature() (constants.ts: a "*" anywhere in the number) flags it and cardSlug() turns the * into an "s" -> /card/galio-indefatigable-t1s-003s-005. The serial box in the name plate ("0001/2025" on Riot's render) is per-copy, not per-printing, so it is deliberately NOT stored here — one Card row covers all 10,125 serials, exactly as the DB has no per-copy identity for any other card.
